subject: Control-plane pin escape plan & preflight validation for EdgeCloud private upgrade
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@edgecloud.io>, Acme Ops <ops@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Control-plane pin escape plan & preflight validation for EdgeCloud private upgrade

Hi Jenna / EdgeCloud ops team,

We're kicking off the preflight for next week's Private deployment upgrade (control-plane components, cert rotation, and agent patching). This thread is to capture the escape/rollback protocols tied to version pinning, plus the validation gates we will run during the maintenance window. Key ask: confirm the network propagation constraints (BGP/routing) and any blackout periods for your customer-facing endpoints.

High-level plan (proposed):
- Maintenance window: Wed 2027-05-05 01:00 - 05:00 PDT (US-west)
- Canary phase: 5% of pods (control-plane proxies + agent bundle) -> smoke tests -> double to 20% -> full fleet if green
- Version pinning: control-plane binary v3.2.1 pinned per tenant; ability to shelve pin back to v3.1.x within 30 minutes via control-plane flag
- Preflight / gates: certificate validity check, KV cache drain validation, schema compatibility check, network ACL diff validation, cluster quorum check
- Rollback triggers: >2% error rate for 10m on essential endpoints, failing schema migration, any certificate chain failure detected

Attachments: preflight-checklist.xlsx (master checklist), network-acls-diff.txt (current vs proposed), canary-rollout-plan.pdf (timings & owners).

Risks specific to EdgeCloud:
- BGP propagation latency for route updates (~2–8 mins typical) — affects drain window for agent IPs
- On-prem firewall stateful sessions may drop connections during cert rotation; recommend a 5m quiet window post-rotation for session re-establishment

Action items / asks:
1) Jenna — confirm whether you want the window shifted later PST or prefer our proposed slot. Also provide the exact public IP ranges that will need temporary exceptions for canary traffic.
2) Ops — confirm there are no scheduled backups or batch jobs that collide with the proposed window.
3) Internal — Monica / Markus: please confirm the rollback owner and the KV drain runbook link to include in the drive folder.

Thanks,
Sooj

--
Soojin Lee
Sr. SRE, Redwood Inference

Hi Soojin — thanks for the summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) IP ranges: we'll allow the canary public ranges you list; final ranges below — please ensure any ephemeral ports used by the agent are documented.
   - 34.210.12.0/24 (canary egress)
   - 34.210.13.0/24 (control-plane egress)

2) BGP: route propagation does occasionally spike to ~12 minutes when flapping occurs. We recommend adding a 15-minute buffer to critical rollback steps where route changes are reversed.

3) Maintenance window: Wed 2027-05-05 02:00 - 06:00 PDT would be safer for our east-coast customers. We can accept 02:00 start.

4) Blackout: no customer backups scheduled in that window, but our monitoring team will be on standby. We will provide a teleconference link once window confirmed.

Finally — if you plan to rotate CA certs, please send the cert chain in advance for our validation (we'll have our security team run a fast compatibility check).

— Jenna

Subject: Re: Control-plane pin escape plan & preflight validation for EdgeCloud private upgrade

Thanks Jenna — updated notes below based on your feedback. I'm adding a tighter set of gating criteria and rollback owners so we can be confident we have an actionable escape.

Updated gating & rollback plan: 
- Start time: 2027-05-05 02:00 PDT (per EdgeCloud request).
- Preflight (T-24h): Certificate chain upload to drive + our automated validator run (owner: Rishi).
- T-1h checks: network-acl diff applied on a test host and connectivity smoke (owner: Markus).
- Canary policy: 5% -> 20% -> 100% with 15-minute observation windows. Canary observed metrics: 500, 502, and 503 counts; median tail latency (p95/p99); kv_get error rate.
- Rollback owners & actions: 
   * Immediate rollback (owner: Markus): If any of the following within a 15-minute window: p99 latency > 3x baseline, kv_get error rate > 2%, or persistent certificate chain failures. Action: shelve control-plane flag -> re-deploy prior bundle (v3.1.x) and evict new agent pods.
   * Controlled rollback (owner: Rishi): If systemic issues observed during full rollout, initiate staged unpin: lock new version, schedule rollback runbook, notify EdgeCloud ops and pause all downstream rollouts.
- KV cache drain: perform prefix drains on canary tenants before scaling canary percentage. Verify cache warmup on previous version after rollback test.

We will also add extra telemetry hooks to capture the certificate handshake failures (we've had a couple of false positives in past rotations). I've uploaded the preliminary runbook and the preflight checklist to the drive link in metadata.

Attachments: added quick-runbook snippet to preflight-checklist.xlsx (tab: rollback_owners).

I'll be on the war room during the window; Markus will own rollback execution and Rishi owns the certificate validation. Jenna — once you share the cert bundle and final IP list, I'll lock the checklist and send the dial-in.

— Monica
Monica Patel

All — final confirmation and owners below. We will proceed with the 2027-05-05 02:00 - 06:00 PDT window unless EdgeCloud requests otherwise by EOD tomorrow.

Final checklist highlights (owners):
- Dial-in / wartime channel: Jenna / EdgeCloud ops to provide (Jenna)
- Certificate validation (preflight T-24h): Rishi
- Network ACL smoke (T-1h): Markus
- Canary rollout orchestration & immediate rollback: Markus
- KV drain & cache warmup validation: Monica
- Post-rollout regression checks (T+1h): Monica / Rishi

Rollback procedures (condensed):
1) Pause rollout and set pin to v3.1.x via control-plane flag (Markus)
2) Trigger evac for new-agent pods and re-schedule onto previous image (Markus)
3) Run KV consistency check and confirm previous cache hit rates (Monica)
4) Notify EdgeCloud and re-open monitoring for a 30-minute observation window (Rishi)

If there are no objections, I'll update the drive runbook with owner sections and send the final calendar invite.

Markus
